\chapter{Boolean Analysis — DNF}
%%% generated by the blueprint pipeline from TCSlib.BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.Applications.KKL.DNF
\section{Overview}
Bounded-width disjunctive normal forms have explicit Fourier tails and total influence bounds. These estimates yield Boolean junta approximations whose coordinate count is polynomial in reciprocal error for each fixed width.

\section{Declarations}

\begin{theorem}[Fourier tail of a regular DNF]
\lean{BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.dnf_fourierWeightAbove_le}
\leanok
\uses{BooleanAnalysis.ThresholdFunctions.fourierWeightAbove, BooleanAnalysis.boolToSign, BooleanAnalysis.fourierCoeff, DNF, DNF.eval, DNF.width, SwitchingBernoulli.switching_bernoulli_dtDepth_dnf}
\difficulty{6}
Let $d$ be a DNF on $n$ variables of width at most a positive integer $w$. Suppose every term has no repeated literals and any two literals in a term sharing a variable are equal. For every $t\in\mathbb N$, its sign encoding $f(x)=(-1)^{d(x)}$ satisfies $\sum_{|S|>120w(t+1)}\widehat f(S)^2\le8\,2^{-t}$ under the uniform cube law.
\end{theorem}

\begin{lemma}[Sensitivity at a satisfying DNF input]

\difficulty{5}
Let $d$ be a DNF on $n$ variables and let $x\in\{0,1\}^n$ satisfy $d(x)=1$. The number of coordinates whose individual flip changes the sign encoding $(-1)^{d(x)}$ is at most the width of $d$.

\begin{lemma}[DNF total influence bound]
\lean{BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.dnf_totalInfluence_le_two_mul_width}
\leanok
\uses{BooleanAnalysis.BoolCube, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.dnf_sensitivity_true_le_width, BooleanAnalysis.ThresholdFunctions.expect_add, BooleanAnalysis.ThresholdFunctions.expect_const, BooleanAnalysis.ThresholdFunctions.expect_mono, BooleanAnalysis.boolToSign, BooleanAnalysis.expect, BooleanAnalysis.expect_eq_fintypeExpect, BooleanAnalysis.flipBit, BooleanAnalysis.flipBit_flipBit, BooleanAnalysis.influence, BooleanAnalysis.sensitivity, BooleanAnalysis.totalInfluence, DNF, DNF.eval, DNF.width}
\difficulty{5}
For every DNF $d$ on $n$ variables, the total influence under the uniform cube law of $x\mapsto(-1)^{d(x)}$ is at most twice the width of $d$. For a real cube function $h$, define $I_i(h)=\tfrac14\mathbb E_x(h(x)-h(x^{(i)}))^2$, where $x^{(i)}$ flips coordinate $i$ and $\mathbb E_x$ is uniform expectation, and $I(h)=\sum_{i=0}^{n-1}I_i(h)$.
\end{lemma}

\begin{lemma}[Parameters for DNF approximation]
\lean{BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.dnf_junta_parameters}
\leanok
\difficulty{6}
There exists an absolute $C>0$ such that for every positive integer $w$ and $0<\varepsilon\le1/2$, there exists $t\in\mathbb N$ satisfying $8\,2^{-t}\le\varepsilon$ and $((2w)^3/\varepsilon^2)9^{120w(t+1)}\le(1/\varepsilon)^{Cw}$.
\end{lemma}
